title: Ukraine unveils tiny 'aircraft carrier' but for FPV drone — will submarine UAV launcher be next?
summary: Ukraine has unveiled a small unmanned surface vehicle designed to act as a mobile launch platform for FPV drones during combat operations. The development follows other Ukrainian experiments involving multiple unmanned platforms working together during military operations across different operational environments.
